package_version_source: docs/literature/raw/description_honestdid.txt; repository declaration, not proof of latest published release
capabilities: Robust confidence sets under restricted trend violations
limitation: Sensitivity restriction is substantive, not learned truth
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Event-study contrast vector, its full covariance, pre/post ordering, contrast weights and a specified trend-violation class.
scientific_qualification.output: Restriction-dependent identified/confidence sets and a sensitivity curve.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: The chosen restriction on post-treatment violations and the asymptotic approximation for input estimates hold.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Keep relative-magnitude and smoothness restrictions distinct, including time units and baseline normalization. Do not treat the worst observed pretrend as a known population bound.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Use a finite trend polytope with independently solved extrema, and known-covariance simulations for coverage; vary preperiod precision while holding the restriction fixed.

evidence.finding: Relative-magnitude/smoothness restrictions and inference accounting for pretrend estimation uncertainty.
